correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed from output/artifacts/cert_matrices.npz. MDADT arithmetic verified: ln(3.8)/2=0.66750053, ln(1.7)/2.6=0.20408779, ln(0.6)/(-2)=0.25541281 versus new ln(3.0)/2=0.54930614, ln(1.6)/2.6=0.18077063, ln(0.64)/(-2)=0.22314355, all strictly smaller. All 9 matrices symmetric with positive minimum eigenvalues (P: 0.539/0.359/0.227; Q: 0.0440/0.0292/0.0184; R: 0.00438/0.00294/0.00185). Assembled the paper's Proposition-1 8x8 Wirtinger LMI (Psi blocks with 4/h, 2/h, 6/h, -6/h, -12/h e^{-alpha beta h} factors plus Schur hA'R/hB'R/-hR extension, matching the extracted proof display) and reproduced the reported maxima to ~1e-11: -4.81187355e-04, -9.72279007e-05, -9.57210465e-05, all strictly negative. All 18 coupling orders P/Q/R_i <= mu'_i P/Q/R_j hold strictly (worst -2.71412046e-05 for R3-0.64 R2, reproduced exactly), with mu2'*mu3'=1.024>=1. Thin but ~1e6x above double-precision noise relative to matrix norms; draft honestly flags non-interval verification and the tau=0.2 inference from d(t)=0.2 sin t.
